# One API for every document.Turn your first document intostructured JSON. Start free.

Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit 30+ file types. Production-ready structured JSON in minutes, not months — starting with $150 in free credits.

- $150 in free credits

Helping everyone from startups to Fortune 10 enterprises unlock their data.

Why Reducto

## Accuracy you can ship on, from the first call.

Reducto combines computer vision with vision-language models so the hardest documents — dense tables, scans, handwriting, nested layouts — come back as clean, cited JSON.

```
from reducto import Reducto

client = Reducto()
result = client.parse.run(
    input="https://cdn.reducto.ai/samples/fidelity-example.pdf",
    settings={"model": "r-1"},
)

for chunk in result.result.chunks:
    print(chunk.content)
```

Accuracy on complex PDFsUp to 100%

File types through one API30+

Per page with Parse r-11¢

Free credits to get started$150

Platform

## The full document lifecycle, one API.

Five endpoints plus a visual Studio for testing, tuning, and deploying pipelines. Supports 30+ file types.

Parse

Convert any document into structured JSON with text, tables, and figures. Layout-aware chunking optimized for LLMs.

Extract

Pull typed fields out of any document with a JSON schema. Every value comes back with a citation and bounding box.

Classify

Route documents by type with your own categories — no training data, no templates.

Split

Break bundled files into their component documents by page range, ready for downstream extraction.

Edit

Fill forms and redact or replace content in place, preserving the original layout.

30+ file types

PDFs, images, spreadsheets, slides, Word docs, and more — including scans, faxes, and handwriting in 100+ languages.

Every endpoint is included with your free credits. Create your key and start building.

[Get your free API key](https://studio.reducto.ai)
